items.text: Colts WR Alec Pierce out next several weeks rehabbing aggravated heel (prior spring surgery); likely IR, hoping midseason return without (or delaying) further surgery. Colts signed Darius Slayton for depth.
items.why: Reaggravated surgically repaired heel in Week 2 vs KC.
items.implication: Big-play WR void; Josh Downs and new depth elevate.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes to Downs, other Colts WRs.

items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart believed to have suffered sprained MCL on MNF opening drive; X-rays negative, MRI Tuesday, expected to miss some time (positive vs catastrophic). Ruled out for remainder of game. Harbaugh: 'in the neighborhood' of MCL, not devastating.
items.why: Knee hyper-extension on hit; initial exams sprained MCL.
items.implication: Miss 2-4+ weeks possible; Jameis Winston starts interim. Giants offense downgraded.
items.opportunity: RB opportunity remains for Skattebo lead; pass game volatility.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) officially inactive for MNF vs Giants. ETR confirmed with projections update; Rapoport also reported inactive.
items.why: Hip injury; true GTD resolved to out.
items.implication: Rams WR targets redistribute; Adams primary, depth WRs/TEs elevate short-term.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to Adams, Ferguson, Mumpfield, Parkinson

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert sprained MCL vs Titans, expected to miss a few weeks. Eagles signing Zach Ertz to practice squad with intent to promote.
items.why: MCL sprain confirmed post-MRI/tests after exiting Week 2.
items.implication: TE void short-term; Mundt/Ertz fill-in, targets may spill to WRs.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to DeVonta Smith, Dontayvion Wicks, Mundt/Ertz.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels underwent imaging on dislocated left elbow (same as prior); consulting specialists next days per protocol. Marcus Mariota expected to start vs Seahawks.
items.why: Dislocated left elbow bracing fall; no fracture on X-ray, further eval.
items.implication: Indefinite short-term; Mariota starts Week 3, offense downgraded.
items.opportunity: Limited for WAS skill; monitor return timeline.

items.text: With Puka Nacua out, on 33 Stafford dropbacks: Davante Adams 27 routes, Terrance Ferguson 23, Konata Mumpfield 21, Xavier Smith 19, Atwell/Parkinson 10 each.
items.why: Route distribution data with Nacua inactive.
items.implication: Adams locked WR1; Ferguson/Mumpfield/Parkinson viable pivots if Nacua misses more.
items.opportunity: High route shares for Adams + depth.

items.text: Giants all four RBs active MNF but Tyrone Tracy ST-only (1 off snap). Cam Skattebo led: 34 snaps/16 opportunities; Singletary 15/4; Najee Harris 8/4 (debut).
items.why: Post-game snap/opportunity counts with Dart out early.
items.implication: Skattebo clear lead back even with Dart injury; hold/start with confidence.

items.text: DeVonta Smith target shares 27%/38% first two games; leading WRs in expected PPR. Berry: RIDE. OR. DIE.
items.why: High target share + model expected points; amplified by Goedert absence.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start with upside from TE void.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE (cracked rib). RJ Harvey inactive (hamstring); grab Jonah Coleman. Aligns with ETR/Levitan optimism and not-expected.
items.implication: McConkey playable with docks; Coleman elevated for Harvey absence.
items.opportunity: Coleman carries/snaps; McConkey routes with flak possible.

items.text: ETR weekend fantasy injury summary: GTD Ladd McConkey (cracked rib, optimism/flak) + Puka Nacua (hip); not expected RJ Harvey (hamstring); expected Olave (ham), Burrow (back), others; OUT Zay Flowers (ham), Michael Pittman (foot).
items.implication: McConkey docks but projected in; Harvey absence opens Coleman; Flowers/Pittman out create stashes.
items.opportunity: Snap/role for backups behind OUT/not expected.

items.text: Kyren Williams 7 opportunities inside 20 this season vs Blake Corum 0 (last year 60-27). Clear goal-line/RZ lead.
items.implication: Kyren remains locked RB1 with TD upside; Corum limited.

items.text: With Puka out, anyone's guess on attack; Berry prefers Colby Parkinson if flex open, else Malachi Fields then Konata Mumpfield at WR.
items.implication: Stream TE/WR depth behind Adams if Nacua sits.
items.opportunity: Potential elevated routes/targets for named pivots.

items.text: Quentin Johnston YPRR by year: 2023 0.88, 2024 1.63, 2025 1.44, 2026 0.48 (horrific). Continued inefficiency.
items.why: Yards per route run trend data.
items.implication: Avoid/start-sit caution despite volume potential; efficiency tank.

items.text: Agrees on deep stash Germie Bernard (YAC, Pittman out, fits McCarthy offense); also Sarratt noted with Lane/Flowers issues.
items.why: Pittman out creates opportunity; scheme fit.
items.implication: Deep-league stash/waiver add for Pittman absence.
